【原视频简介】
Join Grandma in the peaceful countryside as she prepares a delicious and traditional Kenyan githeri with fresh pumpkins using simple, authentic cooking methods passed down through generations. In this heartwarming village cooking video, Grandma takes us through the process of preparing a wholesome homemade meal while enjoying the calm beauty of traditional rural life.

Watch as Grandma carefully cooks githeri (a traditional mixture of maize and beans) together with fresh pumpkins, creating a nutritious, filling, and flavorful family meal. This simple recipe brings together the taste of traditional Kenyan food, the warmth of home cooking, and the beautiful traditions of village life.

From preparing the ingredients to cooking the githeri and pumpkins over a traditional fire, every moment captures the beauty of African village cooking and Grandma's traditional way of preparing food.

🍲 In this video you will see:

Grandma cooking traditional Kenyan githeri
Fresh pumpkins prepared for a delicious meal
Authentic African village cooking
Traditional firewood cooking
Simple homemade Kenyan food
Peaceful countryside and rural village life
Traditional cooking skills passed down through generations
A wholesome family meal made with natural ingredients

If you enjoy traditional African food, Kenyan village cooking, Grandma's recipes, rural life, authentic cooking, and traditional food preparation, make sure to watch until the end.
